categories.main_business_segments: DoubleVerify operates as a single business segment, providing a comprehensive media effectiveness platform for digital advertising. Its primary offerings include solutions for ad measurement and analytics, brand safety and suitability, fraud detection, viewability, and geographic compliance, serving both advertisers (activation and measurement) and supply-side customers (publishers and platforms).
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages proprietary AI-driven technology, machine learning, and semantic science for real-time ad verification and analytics. Its platform, DV Pinnacle, integrates deeply with programmatic, social, and CTV channels, using advanced content classification, fraud detection models, and privacy frameworks that do not rely on third-party cookies or persistent identifiers. The technology stack is scalable, highly available, and certified by industry bodies such as the MRC and ISO.
categories.primary_customers_markets: DoubleVerify serves over 2,000 customers, including a majority of the top 100 global advertisers across industries such as CPG, financial services, telecom, technology, automotive, and healthcare. Its solutions are used by both buy-side (advertisers, agencies) and supply-side (publishers, ad platforms) participants in the digital advertising ecosystem.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates globally, with offices or commercial operations in 31 locations across 25 countries, including the US, UK, Israel, Singapore, Australia, Brazil, Germany, and the UAE. Approximately 42% of employees are located outside the Americas, and its solutions are activated in 110 countries.
categories.supply_chain_position: DoubleVerify functions as an independent, third-party measurement and analytics provider, positioned midstream in the digital advertising supply chain. It sits between advertisers/agencies (buyers) and publishers/platforms (sellers), providing verification, analytics, and optimization data to both sides.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategic priorities include expanding its AI and machine learning capabilities, developing privacy-friendly and cookie-less measurement solutions, and innovating in emerging channels such as CTV and mobile in-app. R&D is focused on product development, fraud detection, content classification, and international expansion, supported by significant investment and a global engineering team.
categories.revenue_model: DoubleVerify primarily generates revenue from measured transaction fees charged to advertisers based on the volume of media transactions (impressions) analyzed. Additional revenue comes from supply-side customers via subscription or tiered contracts. The business benefits from recurring, usage-based fees and long-term customer relationships.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Major competitors include Integral Ad Science, Scope3, Zefr, Nielsen, Comscore, Protected Media, and platform-owned solutions from The Trade Desk, Meta, and Google. DoubleVerify differentiates itself as an independent, unified, MRC-accredited provider with broad ecosystem integrations and a strong reputation for innovation and reliability.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, DoubleVerify reported $656.8 million in revenue (15% YoY growth), $56.2 million in net income, and $218.9 million in adjusted EBITDA (33% margin). The company has delivered a 25% CAGR in revenue from 2021 to 2024, maintains over 95% gross revenue retention, and has a strong balance sheet with $292.8 million in cash and no debt as of year-end 2024.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: DoubleVerify offers advertisers and publishers unbiased, real-time analytics to maximize the effectiveness and ROI of digital ad spend, reduce fraud, and protect brand reputation. Its unique DV Authentic Ad metric, privacy-friendly solutions, deep integrations, and industry certifications provide a compelling value proposition centered on trust, transparency, and measurable business outcomes.
